lines: Mere hamnafas, mere hamnawa
couplets.en: My companion, my kindred voice.

lines: Mere hamnafas, mere hamnawa, mujhe dost ban ke dagha na de
couplets.en: My companion, my kindred voice, do not betray me in the guise of a friend.

lines: Mere hamnafas, mere hamnawa, mujhe dost ban ke dagha na de

lines: Main hoon dard-e-ishq se jaan-ba-lab, mujhe zindagi ki dua na de
couplets.en: Love's pain has brought me to my last breath, so do not pray that I live.

lines: Mere daagh-e-dil se hai roshni, isi roshni se hai zindagi
couplets.en: The wound in my heart gives light, and by that light I live.

lines: Mere daagh-e-dil se hai roshni, isi roshni se hai zindagi

lines: Mujhe dar hai, ae mere charagar, yeh chiraagh tu hi bujha na de
couplets.en: My healer, I fear you may be the one to put out this lamp.

lines: Mera azm itna buland hai, ke paraaye sholon ka dar nahin
couplets.en: My resolve is so strong that I have no fear of flames from elsewhere.

lines: Mujhe chhor de mere haal par, tera kya bharosa hai charagar

lines: Yeh teri nawazish-e-mukhtasar, mera dard aur barha na de
